children: Aboitiz Power likely offers earnings stability, Maybank Securities' Germaine Guinto says in a research report. The analyst says drivers are: 85% of its portfolio is contracted, growth from its electricity generation capacity expansion, and its dividend yield of around 5%. Aboitiz Power is a power company with stakes in three of the Philippines' key power suppliers, which play an essential role in meeting the country's electricity demand. The brokerage forecasts the Philippine company's net income to grow 10% in 2027 and 7% in 2028, partly supported by substantial capacity additions from 2026. It initiates coverage of the stock with a buy rating and a target price of 65.00 pesos. Shares are 1.3% higher at 46.10 pesos.(ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
